Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Are you ready to drive mobile test automation strategies across iOS and Android platforms using WebdriverIO, Appium, and modern API testing tools?
 If you enjoy designing robust mobile automation frameworks, automating complex APIs, and integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines, this role is for you.
 Our philosophy is “First who, then what.” 
 📍 This role is hybrid, with 50% of the month on site in Bucharest.
 🚀 First who? 
3+ years of experience in UI mobile test automation across both iOS and Android.
Hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, WebdriverIO, Appium, Cucumber (BDD), and BrowserStack.
Proven experience in API test automation (REST Assured and/or Supertest, Axios, Super-Agent).
Practical experience with NPM (dependencies, scripts), Git workflows, and manual API testing (Postman, Bruno).
Solid background in test management tools (Jira, Octane) and reporting frameworks (Allure).
Experience in banking or financial projects is a strong plus.
Fluent in English with strong analytical, communication, and debugging abilities.
 🚀 Then what? 
You’ll propose, design, and maintain mobile automation strategies across iOS and Android applications.
You’ll ensure end-to-end traceability, data integrity, and compliance across complex functional flows.
You’ll embed automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable early defect detection and fast feedback loops.
You’ll collaborate closely with developers, PMs, and business stakeholders in an Agile delivery model.
 ⚙️ Your toolbox Technical Skills 
Mobile UI Automation: WebdriverIO, Appium, Cucumber, BrowserStack
Core Language & Tools: JavaScript, Node.js / NPM
API Testing & Automation: REST Assured, Axios, Supertest, Postman, Bruno
Test Management & Reporting: Allure, Jira, Octane
Version Control: Git (merge, rebase, branching workflows)
CI/CD Pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitLab) - plus
Banking / Fintech domain experience - plus
ISTQB Certification - plus
 General Skills 
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving mindset
Detail-oriented approach with a user-centric focus
Clear written and verbal communication for presenting test strategies and metrics
Effective prioritization and time management within Agile/Scrum teams
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the First who and see yourself thriving in the Then what? 
 👉 Apply now and let’s talk.
